def fit(cols,names):
    M=np.column_stack(cols)
    c,res,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(M,dA_dt,rcond=None)
    pred=M@c
    nmse=np.mean((pred-dA_dt)**2)/np.var(dA_dt)
    print(round(nmse,6), dict(zip(names,np.round(c,4))))
